title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 78
description: Ten questions on Psalms 78: lessons from Israel's history, from Egypt and the wilderness to Shiloh and David the shepherd.

questions.text: How does the speaker say he will open his mouth in verse 2?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 says: "I will open my mouth in a parable."

questions.text: Which children, armed and carrying bows, turned back in the day of battle?
questions.explanation: Verse 9 says: "The children of Ephraim, being armed and carrying bows, turned back in the day of battle."

questions.text: In which field did God do marvelous things, according to verse 12?
questions.explanation: Verse 12 says he did marvelous things in the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.

questions.text: What led the people all night?
questions.explanation: Verse 14 says he led them in the daytime with a cloud, and all night with a light of fire.

questions.text: What did the people ask when they spoke against God?
questions.explanation: Verse 19 says they asked, "Can God prepare a table in the wilderness?"

answers.text: "Can God make the sun stand still over us?"
"Can God build us a city in the desert?"
"Can God prepare a table in the wilderness?"
"Can God raise the dead from their graves?"

questions.text: What does verse 25 say man ate?
questions.explanation: Verses 24-25 say God rained down manna on them to eat, and man ate the bread of angels.

questions.text: God rained winged birds on them like what?
questions.explanation: Verse 27 says he rained meat on them as the dust, winged birds as the sand of the seas.

questions.text: Into what did God turn the rivers of Egypt, according to verse 44?
questions.explanation: Verse 44 says he turned their rivers into blood, so that they could not drink.
Verse 60 says he abandoned the tent of Shiloh, the tent which he placed among men.

questions.text: From where did God take David his servant?
questions.explanation: Verse 70 says he chose David his servant and took him from the sheepfolds.
